svg.title: How governance as code works, from pull request to Unity Catalog and Ontos
svg.desc: Four lanes, left to right. 1 Create: a Data Producer runs dpi new-product, writes the ODCS contract, the access file and the ODPS product file, and opens a pull request. 2 Review and approve: contract CI runs datacontract lint, dpi check-mandatory, dpi check-products and dpi check-expectations (blocking) and datacontract test (advisory), then the Data Stewards approve. 3 Build: fetch-rules.sh copies the merged contract into the bundle, which deploys to dev, then to prod after an approval, and rules.apply turns the rules into Lakeflow expectations. 4 Publish: the publisher identity checks schema drift, sets comments, tags and grants in Unity Catalog, and syncs contracts and data products to Ontos. Below, the lifecycle from draft G1 to active G4.
